ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain SOUND ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Smell ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
